summary: Visual Goals page bug fixes testing complete. 7 of 8 features verified working. Pink gradient header, filter tabs persistence, Goal Detail hero image, Edit Goal image upload, back button navigation, and all goal cards with visible images all PASS. Emergency Fund image shows fallback house image due to corrupted uploaded image file (1KB truncated PNG).

ui_bugs.issue: Shows house image instead of piggy bank. The uploaded image file (7eb8f1d2-dfab-4b91-9c93-25f0385073dc_4323ad55.png) is only 1KB and appears corrupted/truncated. The onError handler falls back to a generic house image.
ui_bugs.root_cause: Data issue - uploaded image file is corrupted (1033 bytes vs expected ~1MB for PNG). The row thumbnail shows correct image because it uses CSS background-image which may handle errors differently.

pink_gradient_header.details: Header gradient verified: linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(232, 160, 191) 0%, rgb(212, 120, 156) 40%, rgb(242, 181, 212) 100%) - PINK colors confirmed

filter_tabs_persistence.details: Filter tabs (All/Active/Completed) remain visible when Completed is selected with 0 goals. Shows 'No Achievements Yet' empty state.

emergency_fund_image.details: Row thumbnail shows correct Emergent CDN image. Scroll card shows fallback house image due to corrupted uploaded file.

goal_detail_hero_image.details: Dream Home goal detail page shows hero image (Pexels house image) with data-testid='goal-detail-hero-image'

edit_goal_image_upload.details: Edit Goal page has 'Upload a dream image' section with data-testid='upload-image-btn'. Accepts JPG, PNG up to 5MB.

back_button_navigation.details: Goal Detail back button navigates to /dream-goals (not /my-goals)

all_cards_have_images.details: All 6 goal cards have visible background images (5 from Pexels, 1 from uploaded file)

action_items: OPTIONAL: Re-upload Emergency Fund goal image to fix corrupted file, or remove the goalImage field to use keyword-based fallback
critical_code_review_comments: Code implementation is correct - pink gradient CSS verified
Filter tabs logic correctly shows tabs even when filtered list is empty
Hero image in GoalDetail uses keyword mapping correctly
Image upload section present in GoalForm for both create and edit modes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual Goals page at /dream-goals has pink gradient header (not brown). Filter tabs persist when Completed selected. Goal Detail shows hero image. Edit Goal has image upload. Back button goes to /dream-goals. Emergency Fund card shows fallback house image due to corrupted uploaded file (1KB) - this is a data issue, not code issue.
